title: Precious Gemstones
description: Certified natural precious stones including Diamonds, Rubies, Sapphires (Blue, Yellow, White, Pink, Green), Emeralds, and more — available with treatment details (untreated, heat, GF, dyed).

title: Semi-Precious Gemstones
description: A wide range of semi-precious stones — Amethyst, Citrine, Topaz, Aquamarine, Moonstone, Opal, Zircon, Spinel, Tourmaline, Tanzanite, Iolite, Lapis Lazuli, Jade, Agate, Carnelian, Onyx, and 20+ more.

title: Loose Diamonds
description: Graded loose diamonds available in white, yellow, and blue varieties. Classified by quality grades (AAA Premium, AA Fine, A Commercial, B Lower Grade), shapes, and carat weights.

title: Diamond Jewellery
description: Handcrafted diamond jewellery set in gold and platinum. Custom designs available in all gem shapes — Round, Oval, Pear, Cushion, Princess, Emerald Cut, Heart, Marquise, and Cabochon.

title: Gold Jewellery
description: Exquisite gold jewellery collections crafted in-house. Covers traditional and contemporary designs for all occasions, backed by 30 years of manufacturing expertise since 2005.

title: Silver Jewellery
description: Sterling silver jewellery featuring a curated range of designs. Ideal for everyday wear and gifting, with options for gemstone-studded and plain silver pieces.

title: Gem Testing Lab Services
description: Professional gemstone certification and testing. Identifies stone type, origin, treatments (heat, GF, dye, untreated), and quality grading. Trusted certification backed by decades of lab expertise.

title: Astrology Services
description: Personalized gemstone guidance based on astrological charts. Recommends the right stones for planetary benefits, with expert consultation on wearing methods and authentic sourcing.
